activity_summary: After the Knave you struck a line that was too pleased with itself and put a plainer one under it. You did not write the owl or the cuckoo. The messenger's half-line is still empty. The last line of the comedy is not written.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Struck the conceit and did not finish the act.
